description: a massive golem arm of rough gray stone blocks with glowing blue cracks between them, and a blocky stone hand
a huge heavily muscled green ogre forearm with thick veins and a big rough hand with dirty nails
a bulky armored cyborg leg of thick riveted dark steel plates over hydraulic pistons, with a heavy armored foot
a long-sleeved shirt of fine gray steel chainmail rings
a polished steel plate cuirass covering the chest and belly, with a raised center ridge and brass rivets, over sleeves of dark padded cloth
steel plate thigh armor and knee cops over dark padded cloth trousers
a steel plate gauntlet with articulated finger plates and a flared cuff
a brown leather glove with a hardened leather bracer and brass studs
a steel plate greave and sabaton, the shin plate reaching up to the knee
a tall dark leather boot with a thick gray fur lining folded over at the top and iron toe cap
steel plate pauldron of three overlapping curved lames with a rolled edge
black iron pauldron with three large spikes and red painted trim
medieval steel war hat helmet, a round steel skull cap with a wide flat brim all around, open face, no handle
closed steel great helm with a flat top, eye slits and breathing holes
